name: Sequential Access via Bit Mask Iteration
definition: An access pattern that iterates over active voxels/nodes by scanning the compact `mChildMask` and `mValueMask` bitmasks embedded in each node, outperforming random access for algorithms invariant to voxel sequence.
summary: Sequential Access via Bit Mask Iteration traverses sparse voxel octrees by scanning compact bitmasks to locate the next active voxel, differing from global indexing methods by focusing on local node traversal without maintaining a contiguous index space across leaf boundaries.
